title: Lane keeper bench · Level 1: Two laps
brief: A lane of two 25 mm black lines, 300 mm apart centre to centre, round a 6 m stadium loop (two 1743 mm straights, two half circles of radius 400 mm). The robot starts on the lane's centre at the south straight's west end, heading east (anticlockwise round the loop), within 30 mm and 5 degrees. Two laps: the clock starts when the robot's centre first crosses the start line, 300 mm along the lane, and stops at its second lap's crossing, which ends the run. A departure is a wheel's middle over a line (within 3.5 mm of its middle) or crossing it; a wheel outside the lane counts one more each full second; the fourth departure ends the run. Score: 100 x min(1.2, par / T) - 15 per departure, between 0 and 100; 0 if not finished (two laps in 90 s with at most three departures). Par 20.9 s. Bench level, not scored for a pass: the level's lane and judge for a page's stand-in camera (CCD §0 item 5).

score.run: if(finished, clamp(100 * min(1.2, par / lapTime) - 15 * departures - 25 * (conesWrong + conesKnocked), 0, 100), 0)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)
